scope: Proposition 3.1 (Representation spaces) of the manuscript “Fontaine–Mazur modularity at the prime 2” (preprints/Fontaine-Mazur-modularity-at-the-prime-2-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 010 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3c8797c7d468cdcc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 10-11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G satisfy Φ2, let D be a continuous two-dimensional determinant over the finite field k, and fix a continuous lift χ of its determinant character. The following statements hold. 1. The determinant deformation functor is represented by a complete Noetherian local O-algebra Rps. There is a finite Rps-algebra E carrying its universal Cayley–Hamilton representation. Matrix representations of E compatible with the universal determinant form an affine scheme of finite type over Rps. Its completion at a closed residual matrix representation is that representation’s framed deformation space. 2. Invariant lines at finitely many closed subgroups can be imposed by closed incidence conditions in products of projective lines. On the absolutely irreducible global locus, existence of such a line with a specified character is closed in the trace and character parameters. 3. Suppose the subgroups’ abelianizations have finitely generated maximal pro-2 quotients. Ad- joining the characters on the specified lines gives a finite extension of the completed trace-and- determinant image. 10 4. At an absolutely irreducible representation over a coefficient field, determinants classify un- framed deformations. After a splitting extension, the framed fiber is a conjugacy orbit of dimension three. These assertions do not require the residual determinant to be multiplicity-free.
